summary: Website project for the institute “Mastermind Study Circle” (admission & coaching center) for NIOS, requiring at least five pages and informational content about vision, coping with failure, NIOS support, and NIOS streams/subjects (sourced from nios.ac.in). Visual theme to use blue and grey. Add an in-website admin page for editing site content.
architectural_notes: Site content for NIOS streams/subjects should be sourced from nios.ac.in.
Visual theme palette should use blue and grey (overrides prior preference to avoid blue/purple primaries).
User requires an admin page inside the website for editing content (not just edits via chat interface).
known_issues: Home page displays unwanted default text/label: "this is a learning experiment site"; user requests removal.

Home page displays an incorrect bold hero/heading message about technology/innovation ("Where ideas become reality. Explore cutting-edge technology and innovation."); user requests replacing it with education/vision-focused text.

existing_features.title: Create a responsive institute website for an admission and coaching center for NIOS (National Institute of Open Schooling) with a top navigation bar and at least five distinct pages.
Add page content in English that communicates the institute’s vision, including motivational guidance about not getting depressed by failure and how NIOS can help learners continue their education.
Create a “NIOS Streams & Subjects” page that summarizes streams and subject options using information sourced from https://nios.ac.in (include a visible “Source: nios.ac.in” reference on the page).

Implement a clear admissions-oriented page that explains the institute’s offerings (admission guidance + coaching support) and provides a contact section (address placeholder, phone placeholder, email placeholder, and a simple contact form UI).
Add one coherent, distinctive visual theme (colors, typography, spacing, and UI patterns) and apply it consistently across all pages; avoid a blue/purple primary palette.
Add generated static images (logo + simple hero/illustrations) and render them from frontend/public/assets/generated (no backend image routing).

Update all user-facing institute branding text to use the institute name “Mastermind Study Circle” (replacing “NIOS Excellence”) while keeping NIOS-related references where they describe the program (NIOS). Update header, footer, and page hero headings/CTAs so the displayed institute name is consistent across the site.

Change the global visual theme to a blue-and-grey palette (including primary, accent, muted, border, and ring colors) and apply it consistently across all pages and components that rely on the theme tokens.
Update the header logo alt text to reflect the institute name “Mastermind Study Circle” and ensure any institute-name-related metadata/labels in shared layout elements match the new branding.
Create a new protected Admin page at route "/admin" that provides an in-website editing panel for Mastermind Study Circle content, using Internet Identity login for access.

Wire the public website pages to render selected text fields from the backend site content model (with sensible defaults matching current hardcoded copy), and ensure the Admin page can edit and persist those fields.

Add an Admin navigation entry that is only visible when the user is authenticated (and optionally only when the user is an authorized admin), without changing existing navigation items or breaking mobile navigation.

Update the Home page hero text so the bold headline and supporting text are education- and vision-focused for Mastermind Study Circle, and remove the current technology/innovation tagline from the Home page.

Ensure the website prominently displays the institute phone number and physical address (in addition to email) in public-facing contact areas using the existing editable contact content (pageId: "contact"). Specifically, the Admissions & Contact page contact card and the global footer must show phone and address values (not omit them) and render phone/email as clickable links (tel: / mailto:) when non-empty.

new_feature_requests.summary: Create an institute website (NIOS admission & coaching center) with at least five pages including vision/motivation content and NIOS streams/subjects info sourced from nios.ac.in.
Add an in-website admin page/panel so the institute can edit website content (basic CMS-style editing) after the site goes live.
Implement backend support for editable site content in the single Motoko actor (backend/main.mo), including read access for the public site and write access restricted to authorized admin principals.
Remove the unwanted default Home page text "This is a learning experiment site." so it no longer appears anywhere on the public Home page.

If the canister has already been deployed with existing stored Home page content containing the unwanted text, add an upgrade-safe migration that updates the stored Home page content to a non-experimental, institute-appropriate message (in English) so the Home page stays clean after upgrade.

Update the Home page bold hero/heading text by removing "Where ideas become reality. Explore cutting-edge technology and innovation." and replacing it with institute-appropriate messaging focused on education and the institute’s vision.

Update the backend default stored Home page content so fresh deployments (and empty state) no longer default to "Home Page" and the technology/innovation body text, and instead default to education- and vision-focused English copy appropriate for Mastermind Study Circle.

Add/adjust an upgrade-safe migration so that if existing canister state contains the legacy Home page header/body values (e.g., header "Home Page" and/or body "Where ideas become reality. Explore cutting-edge technology and innovation."), the stored values are replaced with the new education- and vision-focused English copy during upgrade; otherwise preserve any user-customized Home page content.
Add institute phone number and physical address details to the website (e.g., in the Contact section and/or footer) instead of placeholders.

Initialize a default "contact" page in backend content storage so phone/address/email are consistently available via getPage("contact") without requiring an admin save first. Use the existing frontend defaults (address, phone, email) as the initial values stored for this page.

projectName: Mastermind Study Circle (NIOS Admission & Coaching Center Website)
